ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (22) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Внушение» (vnushenie, 'suggestion') and «предание» (predanie, 'tradition') are kept literal in Tolstoy's thought on war. Attributions follow the print («Рише», Rishe: 'Richet', not the website draft's 'Charles Richet'); Richet's figures and his date of 1855 for the Anglo-French declaration of war on Russia (actually 1854) are kept as printed.

Source observation: [12] «Когда Англия и Франция объявили войну России в 1855 году»: the declaration was made in 1854; probably the quoted author's or Tolstoy's own slip rather than a transcription error. Kept as printed.
